title: Enterprise renewal automation, multi-year incentive design, and security questionnaire alignment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Create a standardized, automatable renewal flow for enterprise customers that combines true-up enforcement, optional multi-year discounts, and a pre-populated security questionnaire package for faster contracting. This ticket covers the product proposal, acceptance criteria for the pilot, and alignment with Legal and Sales Ops for implementation.
background: Sales and Customer Success report friction at renewal: manual true-up calculations, inconsistent discount approvals for multi-year commits, and repeated security questionnaire requests that delay signature. Past pilots (internal notes) showed a 20% faster sign time when templates and clear uplift rules were applied. We need a scalable proposal that can be implemented by Billing + Contracts + Console product teams.
proposal_summary: 1) True-up automation: compute overage at renewal using committed seats/units vs actual usage; auto-generate a true-up invoice draft and an opt-out window for customers. 2) Multi-year incentive band: standardize 1/2/3-year discounts with explicit uplift rules tied to commitment size and historical growth velocity. 3) Security questionnaire alignment: bundle a standard security package (pre-filled SQ responses + SOC/pen-test attachments) that can be attached to the renewal proposal to reduce back-and-forth.
pricing_examples: Example A: Customer A renews for 12 months with 200k tokens expected; committed discount table: 12 months = 8% discount, 24 months = 14%, 36 months = 20%. True-up rule: if actual avg monthly usage exceeds committed by >15% for last 6 months, apply 1.25x uplift on base rate for the exceeded tokens at renewal. Example B: Small enterprise (<$10k ARR) offered one-time onboarding credit instead of multi-year discount.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot): implement automated true-up computation and draft invoice for 10 pilot accounts with Sales Ops; provide pre-filled SQ package. Phase 2: add configurable multi-year discount bands in CRM quoting tool and enable acceptance flows in console. Phase 3: scale to all enterprise renewals and add billing automation to finalize invoices post-signature.
acceptance_criteria: 1) True-up calculation matches manual Finance run for pilot accounts. 2) Sales can select a multi-year band and generate a quote showing net present value and discount savings. 3) Security questionnaire package can be auto-attached and includes links to audit artifacts. 4) Time-to-sign metric improves by >=15% for pilot cohort.
metrics: Primary: time-to-sign (days), renewal close rate, average ARR expansion per renewal, incidence of manual SQ follow-ups. Secondary: number of true-up disputes, average uplift revenue realized at renewal.
risks: - Finance alignment risk on uplift formula accuracy. - Legal/regulatory constraints on fixed multi-year pricing in some regions. - Security artifacts may be outdated; need refresh cadence. - Sales may overuse aggressive discounts if approval guardrails are weak.
